name: Seeed Studio Wio-E5 mini
description: STM32WLE5JC LoRa module on a USB-C carrier with SMA and U.FL antenna connectors; ships with AT-command LoRaWAN firmware (EU868/US915), the easiest way into LoRaWAN.
notes: Factory AT firmware is programmed with read-protection level 1: removing it erases the flash and it cannot be restored.
PB13 doubles as the factory bootloader pin (BOOT button); PB6/PB7 (USART1) are shared with the on-board USB-UART bridge and PA13/PA14 are the SWD pins.
Module transmits only through RFO_HP (up to about +20.8 dBm); 868/915 MHz, LoRa and (G)FSK/(G)MSK/BPSK; headers come as two 1x12 strips that you solder yourself.
